votingBreakdown.description: List of brokers and their votes (for, against, abstain) for proposals as shown in the table. Don't include undefined rows.

totalSharePositions.description: Total shares held by the broker

proposals.description: Breakdown of votes (for, against, abstain) for each proposal by the broker

voteToDate.description: Votes to date for the proposal

abstain.description: Votes to date abstained, must return null if not provided

against.description: Votes to date against, must return null if not provided

for.description: Votes to date for, must return null if not provided

proposalId.description: Proposal ID exactly as it appears, including any asterisks if present

recentVotes.description: Votes cast in the most recent session for the proposal (not votes to date)

abstain.description: Most recent votes abstained, must return null if not provided

against.description: Most recent votes against, must return null if not provided

for.description: Most recent votes for, must return null if not provided

name.description: Name of the broker exactly as it appears. Don't include text in parentheses.

companyState.description: State of the company exactly as it appears

companyZip.description: Zip code of the company's location as it appears

companyAddress.description: Street address of the company exactly as it appears, only including number and street

phone.description: Contact phone number for the company

cusipNumber.description: Unique identifier for the company's shares

transferAgentState.description: State of the transfer agent exactly as it appears

meetingDate.description: Date of the company's meeting as it appears

signerFirstName.description: First name of the signer, located in the signature section

isSigned.description: Indicates whether the document has been signed

transferAgentAddress.description: Street address of the transfer agent exactly as it appears, only including number and street

signerRole.description: Role of the signer, located in the signature section below their first and last name

signedDate.description: Date the document was signed as it appears, must return null if not signed

company.description: Name of the voting company, exactly as it appears in the page header

mailDate.description: Date the document was mailed as it appears

companyCity.description: City of the company exactly as it appears, excluding zip code

recordDate.description: Record date for determining voting eligibility as it appears

transferAgentCity.description: City of the transfer agent as it appears, excluding zip code

transferAgent.description: Name of the transfer agent exactly as it appears, just the name.

transferAgentZip.description: Zip code of the transfer agent's location exactly as it appears

signerLastName.description: Last name of the signer, located in the signature section
